regulations.title: Mobile Food Vendor Registration
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Mobile food vendors may not operate within 200 feet of a brick-and-mortar restaurant serving the same cuisine type. Permitted zones: commercial, mixed-use, and designated food truck parks.
regulations.additional_rules: All mobile food units must display the permit number visibly. Annual renewal required. Must maintain a commissary agreement for food storage and preparation.

regulations.title: Restaurant and Food Service Establishment
required_documents: Food handler certifications for all staff
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Restaurants permitted in commercial and mixed-use zones only. Establishments exceeding 60 seats require additional parking capacity review.
regulations.additional_rules: Kitchens must pass health inspection before opening. Grease trap installation mandatory. Noise ordinance compliance required for establishments operating past 10 PM.

regulations.title: Retail Business Registration
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Retail operations permitted in commercial, mixed-use, and designated retail zones. Home-based retail requires a home occupation permit.
regulations.additional_rules: Stores selling age-restricted products (tobacco, alcohol) require additional licensing. ADA compliance mandatory for physical storefronts.

regulations.title: Professional Services and Consulting
required_documents: Professional certification or degree (for regulated professions)
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Consulting businesses may operate from home with a home occupation permit. No client-facing signage allowed in residential zones.
regulations.additional_rules: Regulated professions (legal, medical, accounting) require valid state board certification. Home-based businesses limited to two non-resident employees.

regulations.title: Construction and Contractor Licensing
required_documents: Proof of contractor insurance (general liability + workers comp)
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Contractor offices permitted in commercial and industrial zones. Equipment storage yards require industrial zoning.
regulations.additional_rules: Electrical and plumbing contractors must hold specific trade licenses. All projects over $5,000 require permit filing with the building department. License must be displayed at job sites.

regulations.title: E-Commerce and Online Business
required_documents: Privacy policy and terms of service documentation
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Home-based e-commerce operations permitted in all zones. No zoning restrictions apply if no inventory is stored on-site exceeding residential storage limits.
regulations.additional_rules: Businesses collecting customer data must comply with data protection regulations. Sales tax collection required for in-state customers. International sellers must verify export compliance.

regulations.title: Fitness and Wellness Facility
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Fitness facilities permitted in commercial and mixed-use zones. Noise impact assessment required if within 100 feet of residential zone.
regulations.additional_rules: Facilities with pools or saunas require additional health department permits. Membership contracts must comply with consumer protection regulations. AED device required on premises.

regulations.title: Childcare and Daycare Facility
required_documents: Background check clearance for all staff
CPR/First Aid certification for all staff
Floor plan with designated activity areas
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Daycare facilities permitted in commercial, institutional, and mixed-use zones. Home-based daycare limited to 6 children without commercial zoning.
regulations.additional_rules: Staff-to-child ratios must comply with state regulations. Minimum 35 square feet of indoor space per child required. All staff must complete 40 hours of early childhood education training. Annual inspections mandatory.

all_businesses: All businesses must register with the Secretary of State
Employer Identification Number (EIN) required if hiring employees
Workers compensation insurance required if hiring employees
Annual renewal required for all permits and licenses
Businesses must maintain records for a minimum of 5 years
general_requirements.fee_notes: All fees are one-time application fees unless noted otherwise. Annual renewal fees are typically 60% of the initial fee.
general_requirements.processing_note: Processing times are estimates and may vary. Expedited processing available for an additional 50% fee.
